events.howToJoin: Watch thisismettlesome.com/lab (Upcoming Classes) for Improv 101 and register there. Questions: ops@thisismettlesome.com.
events.verifyNote: Improv 101's day, time, number of weeks, cost and exact start date aren't posted yet. The address shown is the theater's; check when you register that classes meet there.

events.title: Raleigh Rock Climbing Meetup: Friday climb at Triangle Rock Club Durham
events.timeNote: Fri Nov 20 at 6:30pm. The group climbs on Fridays and rotates among TRC gyms: Nov 13 Salvage Yard (Raleigh), Nov 20 Durham, Nov 27 North Raleigh, Dec 4 Morrisville. Later Durham dates aren't visible yet.
events.address: 1010 Martin Luther King Jr Pkwy, Suite 400, Durham, NC
events.cost: Your first meetup visit to any TRC location is $15, rental harness and shoes included. After that the listing gives the usual meetup rate as $22 'with rental gear if requested'.
events.description: An all-levels climbing group, running since 2006, that meets in the gym's roped area, with optional dinner afterward. Roped climbing pairs you with a partner, which makes meeting people easy.
events.howToJoin: RSVP on Meetup. Check in at the TRC front desk, then go to the roped area at the back of the gym. Dinner afterward is optional (venue TBD).
events.firstTime: RSVP on Meetup first. Check in at the front desk, then head to the roped area at the back. Your first visit is $15 with rental harness and shoes. Dinner afterward is optional.
events.verifyNote: Only some of the group's events are posted, so check Meetup for later Durham Fridays. The four-gym rotation suggests roughly every fourth Friday, but that isn't confirmed.

events.title: Drop-in pickleball at John Chavis Community Center
events.schedule: Indoor open play; times are on the City's schedule page
events.timeNote: The City posts indoor open-play sessions on this center's WebTrac 'Schedule' link (from raleighnc.gov/pickleball). Community centers are closed Nov 26–27.
events.venue: John Chavis Memorial Park Community Center
events.address: 505 Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd, Raleigh, NC 27601
events.cost: $3 single session or $15 four-month pass (good at any City indoor open-play session); nets and balls provided, a few loaner paddles
events.description: City-run drop-in pickleball at the community center closest to downtown. You don't need a partner, so it's an easy way to play with the regulars and get to know them.
events.howToJoin: Check the John Chavis 'Schedule' link on raleighnc.gov/pickleball, then show up. Buy a pass on site (exact change or credit card) and fill out the registration form and waiver, which you can do ahead of time. Other near-downtown centers with open play: Lions Park (516 Dennis Ave, 27604) and Tarboro Road (121 N Tarboro Rd, 27610).
events.verifyNote: Check the City's schedule for days and times. Fees are from the City's page as of 11/05/2026; older prices of $2/$10 may still show elsewhere.

events.title: French Speed Language Exchange (French/English)
events.schedule: Recent sessions were Wednesday evenings; new dates post on Meetup
events.timeNote: Recent sessions (Sept 30–Nov 4, 2026) were Wednesdays at 7 p.m. The group doesn't say how often it meets, and no upcoming events are posted yet. Some sessions are held at Motorco Music Hall, 723 Rigsbee Ave, Durham.
events.description: A speed-style exchange in French and English: you switch partners about every 10 minutes, so you meet many people in one evening.
events.howToJoin: Join the Meetup group (1,200+ members) and RSVP when the next event posts. You should be able to hold a one-on-one conversation in French about everyday topics.
events.verifyNote: Frequency, cost and next date aren't posted yet. Check whether each event is at the Raleigh or the Durham venue.

events.title: Volunteer at SPCA of Wake County
events.schedule: Pick your own shifts after online onboarding; 48 hours a year
events.timeNote: You pick your own shifts after onboarding; shifts are offered AM and PM. There are no fixed orientation dates because onboarding is online. Minimum 48 hours a year, including at least one shift every 6 months.
events.description: Join a volunteer team and work alongside regular volunteers: Butlers (dog, cat or small-pet care), Matchmakers (helping with adoptions), General Cleaning, or Events such as pop-up wellness clinics.
events.howToJoin: Ages 18+. Complete the online orientation, the New Volunteer Application (spcaofwakecounty.my.site.com/volunteer/s/apply) and the waiver, then the training for your task. Questions go to volunteer@spcawake.org (no phone calls).
events.verifyNote: Shift length and times aren't stated. The adoption center is being renovated, so follow signs to a temporary entrance. You may be asked to sign a waiver through DocuSign.

events.title: Volunteer at Wake County Animal Center
events.schedule: About 2-hour shifts, 7 days a week; 6 hours a month for 6 months
events.timeNote: Shifts usually run about 2 hours, any time from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., 7 days a week. Commitment: at least 6 hours a month for 6 months. Orientation is online (videos and a virtual tour emailed during onboarding); no dates are posted.
events.description: Volunteering at the county shelter in regular shifts of about 2 hours, working alongside staff and other volunteers.
events.howToJoin: Ages 18+, no exceptions. Apply online through Better Impact (link on the county volunteer page). The Volunteer Coordinator emails a welcome packet when new volunteers are being onboarded. Contact wcac.volunteer@wake.gov or 919-250-3793.
events.verifyNote: No orientation dates are published; onboarding happens when the coordinator brings on new volunteers. Short-term or one-day volunteering isn't accepted.
